review_method: Unblinded coding-assistant review using the same criteria as Dolos. Targeted spot checks; provisional, not a calibrated benchmark.

Changes 'only the northern gate may open before noon' into a time restriction on that gate ('can only open by noon'), also replacing before with by. The southern inspection condition remains. Two sentences.

Adds an entry requirement and changes permission about gate opening into a requirement to pass through gates. It drops the exclusivity of the northern gate before noon and changes before noon to no later than noon. One sentence.
Final order C-D-A-B swaps A and B, assigning February 29 to A and March 1 to B despite the provided labels. Prose and dates violate labels-only.

Correctly enumerates cases with one through eleven red tickets, but reaches the 512-token cap during the twelve-red case before writing the zero-blue endpoint or a final range. Visible reasoning is supported; the complete requested range cannot be verified from this truncated output.
Gives 12-R with 1 <= R <= 11, incorrectly excluding the all-red case and zero blue tickets. Earlier reasoning inconsistently uses 13-R and wrong example arithmetic. The valid blue range is 0-11.

Makes multiple false physical claims: water denser than steel, a bolt sinking when buoyancy exceeds gravity, and a ship floating while weighing more than displaced water. Eight sentences exceed the three-sentence limit.

The fragmented explanation compares mass and density with volume as if they had the same units and does not give a valid displacement/average-density explanation. It is presented as one run-on sentence across several lines, so no clear breach of the at-most-three-sentence limit.
Correctly identifies the false universal claim and explains that 2 is the only even prime, with all other primes odd. Three sentences exceed the requested two.
Correctly identifies the assumption and gives 2 as an even prime counterexample. Three sentences exceed the requested two.
Requires heating a pan despite no stove, unnecessarily recooks already cooked rice, and adds salt outside the ingredients. Four numbered steps exceed the three-step limit.
Adds salt and pepper outside the permitted ingredient list. It also asks to warm rice without explaining an available method. Three numbered preparation steps satisfy the count limit.
Incorrectly finishes E at 6 instead of 7 and schedules it before C is complete. It changes C's stated start from 2 to 6 and D's from 3 to 4 without justification. A schedule is present.
Correct finish time 7 and valid supporting schedule: A 0-2, B 0-3, C 2-6, D 3-4, E 6-7. Repetitive but no numeric length limit was given.

Friendly and interested in future walks, but omits the firm-plan request and scheduling boundary. Four message sentences exceed the three-sentence limit.
